source_record.description:
Unser Mandant aus dem Raum Bielefeld ist ein international erfolgreich positioniertes, mittelständisches Produktionsunternehmen mit mehreren Auslandsgesellschaften. Im Zuge einer Neuausrichtung befindet sich auch die Finanzorganisation in einer Phase der Professionalisierung und Weiterentwicklung. Für die Gestaltung einer Group Controlling-Organisation als echter Business Partner suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die mit Herz und Hand die Konzeption vornimmt und die operative Umsetzung mitverantwortet. Mit Humor, der notwendigen Lockerheit und Überzeugung in den Themen kreieren Sie eine konstruktive und umsetzungsorientierte Atmosphäre.

Aufgaben

  • Sie übernehmen die aktive Führung eines kleinen Teams und entwickeln die Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern weiter
  • Sie optimieren die Konsolidierung der Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse als Basis für die integrierte Planung und den Forecasts der mittelständischen Gruppe mit in- und ausländischen Gesellschaften nach IFRS
  • Sie verantworten die kaufmännische Betreuung kleinerer Gruppengesellschaften - und führen diese als steuernder Controller
  • Sie entwickeln Analysen und Kommentierungen der Geschäftsentwicklung und übernehmen die qualifizierte Darstellung und Erläuterung von Planabweichungen als Grundlage für unternehmerische Entscheidungen
  • Sie erarbeiten die rollierende Liquiditätsplanung sowie die Bereitstellung der Daten für das Sparring mit der Geschäftsführung
  • Sie sichern den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung von Abschluss- und Planungsprozessen im neuen Konsolidierungstool mit Schnittstellen zu aktuellen ERP-Systemen
  • Sie lieben die Weiterentwicklung des abteilungsübergreifenden KPI-Monitorings als Grundlage für die strategische und operative Steuerung

Qualifikation

  • Sie haben ein abgeschlossenes Studium mit Schwerpunkt Controlling/Finanzen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie mehrjährige Berufs- und Führungserfahrung im Controlling eines internationalen und produzierenden Unternehmens
  • Sie bringen fundierte Controlling und HGB-/ IFRS-Kenntnisse mit und bewegen sich sicher im externen und internen Rechnungswesen
  • Sie haben eine hohe IT-Affinität sowie Erfahrung mit SAP CO/FI und sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse
  • Sie bewegen sich in der deutschen und englischen Sprache im beruflichen Umfeld sehr sicher
  • Sie zeichnen sich durch ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für ganzheitliche Prozesse und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge aus und bringen die Bereitschaft, Veränderungsprozesse maßgeblich voranzutreiben auch mit
  • Sie überzeugen mit einer hohen Zahlenaffinität in Verbindung mit logischem und analytischem Denkvermögen, damit komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich werden
  • Sie schaffen es mit ihrer Kommunikationsstärke, Durchsetzungsvermögen und einem ausgeprägten Team-Spirit die Integration von Prozessen und Systemen mit den Menschen zu schaffenSie kommen mit ihrer eigenverantwortlichen, strukturierten und ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise ans Ziel

Benefits

  • Fixum, Bonus und Firmenwagen
  • Entwicklung & Perspektiven: Flache Hierarchie, internationaler Kontext, langfristige Führungschancen, Teamausbau
  • Zusatzleistungen: Jobrad, Sport-Angebote, VWL usw.
  • Flexibilität & Infrastruktur: Grundsätzlich Homeoffice möglich, kostenfreie Parkplätze
  • Arbeitskultur: Vielfalt, Eigenverantwortung & Innovation in einem dynamischen Umfeld

Wir suchen eine Person mit Herz und Hand. Ein engagierter und pragmatischer Stil zeichnet Sie aus, denn damit passen Sie gut zu unserem Kunden.

Wir verkaufen Sonnenaufgänge über Gipfeln.

Powdertage. Bike-Abenteuer. Hüttenzauber.

Und dieses besondere Gefühl, wenn man nach einem aktiven Tag glücklich ins Bett fällt.

Willst Du genau das verkaufen? Dann lies weiter.

Aufgaben

  • Aktiver Vertrieb unserer 8 Betriebe in Oberstdorf (Hotels, Hütten, Hostel)
  • Betreuung von Individual-Gästen, Firmenkunden, Veranstaltern, Gruppen & Agenturen
  • Vom Erstkontakt bis zur Anreise: Du steuerst den gesamten Prozess
  • Organisation, Gestaltung und Abrechnung von B2B-Events (Tagungen, Gruppenreisen, Hochzeiten)
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Rezeptionsteams in den Hotels
  • Aktive Mitwirkung bei Produkt- und Preisgestaltung
  • Impulse setzen, Märkte entwickeln, Performance steigern
  • Ansprechpartner für Assistenten und Auszubildende bei Fragen

Qualifikation

  • Leidenschaft für Vertrieb und echte Begeisterung für Menschen
  • Du telefonierst gerne und gehst aktiv auf neue Kontakte zu
  • Positive Ausstrahlung & Überzeugungskraft
  • Strukturierte, eigenständige Arbeitsweise
  • Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen
  • Teamplayer mit Drive und Eigeninitiative
  • Ausbildung oder Erfahrung in Hotellerie, Tourismus oder Vertrieb ideal, aber nicht alles. Persönlichkeit zählt.
  • Du bist kein Verwalter. Du bist Möglichmacher.

Benefits

  • Sicherheit & Perspektive: Unbefristete Anstellung in einer der schönsten Regionen Deutschlands.
  • Genuss & Energie: Starte jeden Tag mit unserem kostenlosen, reichhaltigen Frühstücksbuffet.

Klingt nicht nach 08/15? Ist es auch nicht.

wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung.

Senior Frontend Engineer (all genders) Distribusion Technologies Berlin Technology Remote Experienced fulltime permanent 29 minutes Technology Remote Experienced fulltime permanent Berlin 29m Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com. We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by three leading VCs (Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent €30 m Series B, we are ready to push beyond. We are looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to join our eCommerce Solutions team . You will contribute to improving an Online Booking Engine that our partners use to allow their users to search, book, and manage their ground transportation tickets. Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by three leading VCs (Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent €30 m Series B, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to join our eCommerce Solutions team. You will contribute to improving an Online Booking Engine that our partners use to allow their users to search, book, and manage their ground transportation tickets. This is a great chance for you to impact products with a great market fit and high demand.

What you'll do

  • Deliver new features in our eCommerce solutions

  • Actively participate in efforts on frontend architecture initiatives

Workplace: Berlin or Europe

We are a remote-first company, with teams located around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office.


Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field

  • 5-7+ years of software engineering experience with a minimum of 4+ years of professional experience working with TypeScript and React.js

  • Experience testing with Cypress

  • Experience working with public cloud providers (GCP is preferred)

  • You are driven, ambitious, and willing to get hands-on in shaping the future of ground transportation travel

Du suchst einen Berufseinstieg, der Vertrieb, Beratung und persönliche Entwicklung verbindet?
Dann ist dieses Traineeprogramm genau das Richtige für dich.

Wir suchen ambitionierte Persönlichkeiten (m/w/d), die sich im Finanzvertrieb eine langfristige Karriere aufbauen wollen, mit klarem System, praxisnaher Ausbildung und individuellen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
Als Trainee wirst du von Beginn an begleitet, gecoacht und gefördert, mit dem Ziel, dich zu einer lizenzierten Finanzberaterin bzw. einem lizenzierten Finanzberater zu entwickeln.

Dein Aufgabenbereich

  • Einstieg in die Finanzberatung: Du lernst, wie du Kundengespräche professionell führst, Bedarfe erkennst und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen anbietest.

  • Vertrieb & Kundenbetreuung: Du unterstützt bei der Akquise und Beratung von Neukunden und baust schrittweise deinen eigenen Kundenstamm auf.

  • Finanzplanung & Analyse: Du erstellst Analysen und Konzepte in den Bereichen Absicherung, Vorsorge, Investment und Vermögensaufbau.

  • Praxisnahe Ausbildung: Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Beratern zusammen und lernst alle Kernprozesse im Vertrieb kennen.

  • Teamarbeit & Mentoring: Du wirst persönlich durch Kevin Kehr begleitet – mit klarer Struktur, Feedback und individueller Förderung.

Wir bieten

  • Lizenzierte Ausbildung: Vorbereitung auf zwei IHK-Abschlüsse gemäß § 34d GewO (Versicherung) und § 34f GewO (Finanzanlagen)

  • Strukturiertes Traineeprogramm: Klare Lernziele, feste Module, begleitende Schulungen und praxisnahe Umsetzung.

  • Persönliches Mentoring: Direkte Begleitung durch deinen Mentor Kevin Kehr, von der ersten Beratung bis zum eigenen Kundenstamm.

  • Hohe Verdienstmöglichkeiten: Leistungsorientierte Vergütung ohne Einkommensbegrenzung.

  • Karriere mit Perspektive: Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss – Einstieg als Finanzberater oder Entwicklung in Richtung Führungskraft.

  • Flexibilität & Eigenverantwortung: Moderne, ortsunabhängige Arbeitsweise mit klarem Fokus auf Ergebnisse.



Das bringst du mit

  • Abitur oder abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein vergleichbarer/höherwertiger Abschluss

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1-Niveau oder Muttersprache)

  • Wohnsitz in Deutschland

  • Kommunikationsstärke und Freude am Umgang mit Menschen

  • Zuverlässigkeit, Eigeninitiative und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise

This role will largely focus on accounts that want to use Maltego for cybersecurity and CTI use cases. Domain expertise in this area is a firm requirement.

  • Effectively manage all project communication, both internally and externally.

  • Build strong, lasting relationships with clients, serving as the primary point of contact during onboarding.
  • Ensure smooth hand-offs with Sales and Customer Success.
  • Maintain product and domain expertise in Maltego, OSINT, and other relevant domains
  • Up to 50% travel required


Your profile in short

  • 3+ years of experience in cybersecurity or Cyber Threat Intelligence.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills to all levels on the customer side.
  • Strong analytical and goal-oriented mindset backed by project management skills.
  • Ability to de-escalate customer support requests and maintain a positive, goal-driven customer relationship.
  • Moderately technical, with the ability to configure SaaS solutions and provide recommendations.
  • Experience in customer onboarding, customer service, support, account management, or customer success (advantage).

Tool, mit dem wir unseren proprietären Dealflow im Investmentteam im DACH-Software- und Tech-Mittelstand aufbauen. Dein Ziel: attraktive Unternehmen und ihre Gesellschafter frühzeitig identifizieren und erreichen, idealerweise bevor ein M&A-Berater mandatiert oder ein breiter Verkaufsprozess gestartet wird. Dabei verbindest du zwei Welten: AI-/Data-Skills und Deal Origination. Du baust die Daten-, Tool- und Reporting-Infrastruktur, auf der Market Maps, Outbound-Kampagnen, potenzielle Investments und ein skalierbarer Sourcing-Prozess aufsetzen. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem FLEX Leadership Team, dem Investment Team und dem Data & AI Team zusammen und erhältst vom ersten Tag an viel Ownership für den Aufbau einer zentralen Funktion bei FLEX. Du entwickelst es laufend weiter und verbesserst es iterativ. Du entwickelst die Screening- und Priorisierungslogik für Targets und verbesserst deren Trefferqualität systematisch. Du baust die automatisierte Datenbeschaffung und -anreicherung aus, sodass Targets mit Firmographics und Eigentümerstrukturen angereichert werden. Du entwickelst Logik und Workflows, um Intent-Signale und potenzielles Verkaufsinteresse zu erkennen. Du initiierst die automatisierte Multichannel-Ansprache und entwickelst die zugrunde liegenden Prozesse weiter. Du baust Dashboards und Reports zu Funnel, Aktivitäten und Conversion als Grundlage unserer Sourcing- und Pipeline-Reviews. Du evaluierst neue Prospecting- und Sourcing-Tools und entwickelst Ansprache, Sequenzen und unsere Messaging-Bibliothek weiter. Dein Profil Du hast eigene Tools und Automatisierungen programmiert, die produktiv im Einsatz waren, nicht nur Prototypen und Demos. Du bringst mindestens 2 bis 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Aufbau skalierbarer daten- und AI-basierter Produkte/Tools mit. Du entwickelst selbstständig in Python und deployst mit Docker auf Azure in Produktion. Du arbeitest routiniert mit relationalen und NoSQL-Datenbanken und setzt selbstständig nachhaltige Datenmodelle auf. Du kennst LLM-APIs (OpenAI, Claude) aus der Praxis und weißt, wie man daraus hochwertigen Output bekommt (Evals). Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Daten und weißt, worauf es bei Datenqualität und -struktur ankommt. Kenntnisse in Pipedrive, Agentensystemen sowie Frameworks wie LangGraph sind ein Plus. Du denkst kommerziell: Du verstehst, warum ein Target relevant ist, und misst dich an Ergebnissen. Du hast ein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Data Analytics, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren MINT-Fach erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch. Benefits Raum zum Wachsen und die Möglichkeit, viel Verantwortung zu übernehmen, kombiniert mit halbjährlichem Feedback und einem individuellen Weiterbildungsbudget. Persönliche und berufliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch ein inspirierendes und dynamisches Umfeld und flache Hierarchien. Ein attraktives Gehaltspaket inklusive Möglichkeiten zur Brutto-Netto-Optimierung. Hinter FLEX Capital stehen sechs Seriengründer, die mehrfach marktführende Unternehmen mit internationaler Geschäftstätigkeit aufgebaut haben. SNK ist eine reine B2B-Digitalagentur mit über 20 Jahren Erfahrung. Wir entwickeln digitale Plattformen, Websites, Portale, Apps und individuelle Softwarelösungen für führende Industrieunternehmen sowie stark wachsende SaaS- und Tech-Companies. Unser Anspruch: Beratung, Konzept und Umsetzung aus einer Hand, mit Senior-Teams, hohem Qualitätsstandard und klarer Verantwortung. Als Senior Account Manager (m/w/d) bist du die zentrale Informations- und Kommunikationsdrehscheibe zwischen Geschäftsführung, Experten-Teams und Kunden Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unsere wertvollsten Kundenbeziehungen, professionalisierst unser Account Management weiter und entwickelst unseren bestehenden Kundenstamm proaktiv zu neuem Wachstum. Als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Geschäftsführung, Experten-Teams und Kunden bringst du dich bereits in der Vertriebsphase ein, erkennst Marktlücken und Potenziale frühzeitig und führst Kundenbeziehungen strategisch – von der Erstberatung über Workshops bis zum langfristigen Ausbau. Deine Aufgaben: Kundenführung: Du betreust eigenverantwortlich A-Potential-Accounts (sowie ausgewählte B-Accounts), steuerst deren Priorisierung, Ziel- und Maßnahmenplanung und erkennst ungenutzte Potenziale, um daraus neue Projekte anzustoßen und die Pipeline gezielt auszubauen. Bereits in der Pitch- und Angebotsphase gestaltest du Scope und Leistungsversprechen aktiv mit. Beratung & Workshops: Du verantwortest Formate wie jährliche Kunden-Workshops und Reviews und berätst auf Basis der Zielsetzung, Budgets und internen Dynamiken deiner Kunden passgenau. Schnittstelle & Enablement: Du bildest die Brücke zwischen Kunden, Geschäftsführung und Fachteams (z. B. UX, Creative, Digital Marketing) und hilfst Projektmanager:innen, Kundensignale richtig zu deuten und in die operative Arbeit zu übersetzen. Risiko- & Eskalationsmanagement: Du erkennst kritische Kundensignale frühzeitig, klärst Eskalationen auf Entscheiderebene souverän und hältst den Projektteams den Rücken frei. Enger Sparringspartner der Geschäftsführung: Du berichtest regelmäßig zu Status, NRR, Kundenqualität und relevanten KPIs und treibst im engen Austausch die Weiterentwicklung unseres Account-Management-Systems voran. Du bringst mit: Fundierte Erfahrung im Senior / Lead Account Management: Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der strategischen Betreuung und Skalierung von B2B-Bestandskunden im Agentur- oder digitalen Beratungsumfeld. Exzellentes Stakeholder-Management: Du baust ab Tag 1 Glaubwürdigkeit auf C-Level und Sponsorenebene auf und bewegst dich sicher auch in komplexen, konfliktbehafteten Kundensituationen. Souveräne Moderation & Beratung: Erfahrung in Konzeption und Durchführung von Strategie-Workshops sowie in der zielgerichteten Moderation von Kundenterminen. Ausgeprägtes Business- & Finanzverständnis: Kennzahlen wie NRR, Margen, Pipeline-Ökonomie und Kundenrentabilität sind für dich vertrautes Handwerkszeug. Analytisches Gespür & Proaktivität: Du erkennst aus scheinbar kleinen Signalen – etwa veränderten Budgetfreigaben, neuen Ansprechpartnern oder verzögerten Rückmeldungen – frühzeitig Chancen oder Risiken und leitest konkrete nächste Schritte daraus ab. Führung durch Überzeugung: Du überzeugst interdisziplinäre Teams inhaltlich für gemeinsame Ziele, auch ohne disziplinarische Weisungsbefugnis. Deine Benefits: Team & Atmosphäre: Familiäres, teamorientiertes Umfeld mit motivierten Kolleg:innen – hier entstehen Freundschaften. Gute Kommunikation : Offene Feedbackkultur und kurze, unbürokratische Wege. Spannende Aufgaben: Abwechslungsreiche Projekte mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Flexibilität: Home Office und flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance. Transparente Zeitregelung: Jede Überstunde zählt – ab der ersten Minute. Teamevents: Von Dönerstag bis Kinderfasching - wir lieben unsere regelmäßigen gemeinsamen Aktivitäten. Gesundheit & Umwelt: JobRad-Angebot für nachhaltige Mobilität. Das sind wir: In Zahlen: 1 Headquarter, über 100 Köpfe, 16 Nationalitäten schoene neue kinder ist eine wachsende Digitalagentur mit dem Fokus auf Digital Customer Experiences. Unsere DNA besteht zu 100 % aus Design und zu 100 % aus Technologie . Unsere Unternehmenskultur wird von klar definierten Werten getragen, die unser tägliches Miteinander und unsere Arbeit prägen: Qualität steht für uns an erster Stelle – in unseren Projekten, unserer Zusammenarbeit und unseren Lösungen. Wir übernehmen Verantwortung für unser Handeln und treiben unsere Projekte mit Pragmatismus voran, um effizient und wirkungsvoll Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Klare und offene Kommunikation ist die Grundlage unseres Erfolgs – sie fördert nicht nur großartige Ideen, sondern auch eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit. Wir glauben an echten Team Spirit – wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, feiern Erfolge gemeinsam und wachsen miteinander. Und nicht zuletzt: Dankbarkeit ist für uns essentiell – für unser Team, das mit Leidenschaft und Kreativität Großes schafft, für unsere Kunden, die uns ihr Vertrauen schenken, und für die Möglichkeit, gemeinsam digitale Erlebnisse zu gestalten. Klingt nach Dir? Dann bewirb dich direkt – wir freuen uns auf dich!   • Fundierte Erfahrung im Senior / Lead Account Management: Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der strategischen Betreuung und Skalierung von B2B-Bestandskunden im Agentur- oder digitalen Beratungsumfeld.

  • Exzellentes Stakeholder-Management: Du baust ab Tag 1 Glaubwürdigkeit auf C-Level und Sponsorenebene auf und bewegst dich sicher auch in komplexen, konfliktbehafteten Kundensituationen.

  • Souveräne Moderation & Beratung: Erfahrung in Konzeption und Durchführung von Strategie-Workshops sowie in der zielgerichteten Moderation von Kundenterminen.

  • Ausgeprägtes Business- & Finanzverständnis: Kennzahlen wie NRR, Margen, Pipeline-Ökonomie und Kundenrentabilität sind für dich vertrautes Handwerkszeug. 

  • Analytisches Gespür & Proaktivität: Du erkennst aus scheinbar kleinen Signalen – etwa veränderten Budgetfreigaben, neuen Ansprechpartnern oder verzögerten Rückmeldungen – frühzeitig Chancen oder Risiken und leitest konkrete nächste Schritte daraus ab. 

  • Führung durch Überzeugung: Du überzeugst interdisziplinäre Teams inhaltlich für gemeinsame Ziele, auch ohne disziplinarische Weisungsbefugnis.


Deine Benefits:

  • Team & Atmosphäre: Familiäres, teamorientiertes Umfeld mit motivierten Kolleg:innen – hier entstehen Freundschaften.

  • Gute Kommunikation: Offene Feedbackkultur und kurze, unbürokratische Wege.

  • Spannende Aufgaben: Abwechslungsreiche Projekte mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum.

  • Flexibilität: Home Office und flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance. 

  • Transparente Zeitregelung: Jede Überstunde zählt – ab der ersten Minute.

  • Teamevents: Von Dönerstag bis Kinderfasching - wir lieben unsere regelmäßigen gemeinsamen Aktivitäten. 

  • Gesundheit & Umwelt: JobRad-Angebot für nachhaltige Mobilität.


Das sind wir:

In Zahlen: 1 Headquarter, über 100 Köpfe, 16 Nationalitäten 

schoene neue kinder ist eine wachsende Digitalagentur mit dem Fokus auf Digital Customer Experiences. Unsere DNA besteht zu 100 % aus Design und zu 100 % aus Technologie.

Unsere Unternehmenskultur wird von klar definierten Werten getragen, die unser tägliches Miteinander und unsere Arbeit prägen: Qualität steht für uns an erster Stelle – in unseren Projekten, unserer Zusammenarbeit und unseren Lösungen. Klare und offene Kommunikation ist die Grundlage unseres Erfolgs – sie fördert nicht nur großartige Ideen, sondern auch eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit.

Wir glauben an echten Team Spirit – wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, feiern Erfolge gemeinsam und wachsen miteinander.  Und nicht zuletzt: Dankbarkeit ist für uns essentiell – für unser Team, das mit Leidenschaft und Kreativität Großes schafft, für unsere Kunden, die uns ihr Vertrauen schenken, und für die Möglichkeit, gemeinsam digitale Erlebnisse zu gestalten.

Your Mission

EV charging is evolving from a niche technology into everyday infrastructure. As reev grows, teams increasingly need reliable, consistently defined metrics. Today, different dashboards, reporting dates, filters, and assumptions can produce different answers to the same business question. 
This role addresses the problem - not by building more dashboards, but by creating a shared and trustworthy data foundation. The goal is to establish clear definitions and consistent metrics so that teams and leadership can make informed decisions based on the same numbers. Someone who understands that unclear definitions, rather than a lack of data, are often the real problem can make a significant impact in this role. You own the certified layer, the single, agreed upon version of every core metric that reev runs on. You connect the definition, the data model, and the delivery. And when two numbers disagree, you are the person who says which one to trust. 

What you will do 

  • Define core metrics with Finance, Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Engineering, and Platform.
  • Agree on definitions, data contracts, and ownership forcore metrics with the teams that own them.
  • Maintain and verify the certified data layer, built in ETL tooland surfaced in Metabase, so teams can build their own dashboards on top of it.
  • Use SQL to validate data, investigate inconsistencies, and trace numbers back to their sources.
  • Work with Platform team to identify potential improvements in data flows, pipelines, and transformations, advise on next steps, and help prioritize next steps during planning.
  • Help stakeholders decide which number to trust when reports disagree.
  • Improve data literacy through practical guidance, workshops, and clear documentation.
  • Use AI-assisted tools for analysis, documentation, automation, and workflows. Check the results carefully.
 
What this role is not 
You will not be the central owner of every dashboard request. Teams remain responsible for their own dashboards, analyses, and data models built on their data contracts. This is also not a classic infrastructure or people-management role. 



What you bring along

Must-have 

  • Senior experience in BI, analytics, or data. Scale-up experience is helpful.
  • Strong SQL skills.You can read and write SQL,validate data, and trace where a number comes from.
  • Experience defining KPIs with Finance and other business owners.
  • Experience with data models, data quality, or data governance.
  • A good understanding of data flows, pipelines, and transformations.
  • Confidence working with senior stakeholders and challenging unclear or incorrect numbers.
  • A hands-on, business-minded approach. You connect business questions with practical data solutions.
  • Experience with automation, AI Agents, or AI-supported workflows.
  • Fluent written and spoken English, German is a plus.
Nice to have 
  • Experience with Metabase, dbt, AWS Glue, Spark, Airbyte, or comparable tools.
  • Experience with workshops, enablement, or data literacy programmes.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, EV charging, energy, mobility, or a related field.
You do not need every tool on the list. We care most about strong SQL, sound data thinking, and the ability to bring people to one shared definition.


What you can expect from us

How we work 
Clear goals, real ownership, and little politics. We move quickly, decide together, and hold each other accountable.
 
Where you will work 
Our Munich office at Stiglmaierplatz is an important place for collaboration. For this role, we expect at least three days on-site each week. 

What you get 

  • 28 vacation days - Plus additional days off between Christmas and New Year. Good work starts with proper rest.
  • Mental health, taken seriously - Free access to the nilo platform with individual sessions from psychologists and business coaches. We want you balanced, not just productive.
  • AI tools - no limits - Every person and every team at reev uses the AI tools they choose, without budget constraints. We believe in working with the best tools available, and we don't slow that down.
  • Move sustainably - JobRad, subsidised public transport, or EGYM Wellpass. You choose what fits your life.
  • €1,000 learning budget -Yours to use. Plus internal development opportunities. Because when you grow, we all grow.
  • Your future, sorted - Digital, commission-free company pension (bAV) with DYNO. Transparent, with a personal dashboard. No fineprint.

source_record.description:
You are the one we miss!

  • We’re looking for someone with a passion for digital marketing, a keen eye for trends and a clear understanding of the dynamic evolution of search engines and AI-driven response systems (e.g. Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini)
  • You’ll be responsible for developing, implementing and continuously optimising holistic SEO and GEO strategies to boost our clients’ organic visibility
  • In this role, you will develop forward-looking strategies for GEO, for example through structured content approaches, entity optimisation, and by strengthening authority and trustworthiness
  • You will use standard tools such as Sistrix, Semrush, Google Search Console, Peec.ai and Google Analytics to derive data-driven recommendations
  • You bring a deep understanding of technical SEO, content strategies and information architecture, and apply this knowledge when working with the development, UX and editorial teams
  • You continuously refine on-page, off-page and content optimisations, with a focus on traditional search engines and AI systems
  • You always keep a close eye on PageSpeed, Core Web Vitals, structured data and technical SEO
  • It would be a plus if you have experience in setting up and optimising Google Ads campaigns
  • Do you have an agile mindset? Absolutely! Our projects are mainly carried out in an agile environment and we use tools such as Miro, Jira and Confluence
  • You have a very good German skills (C1), as our current projects are predominantly conducted in German. A good command of English is an advantage


What you can look forward to

  • Flexibility & trust: Hybrid working at one of our denkwerk locations & flexible working hours
  • Your health matters: Urban Sports Club membership and JobRad leasing
  • We celebrate success together: Profit sharing for all permanent denkwerk employees, big parties, and event formats
  • Your development is important to us: Training budget for new skills and training; denkwerk inspiration in form of tech talks, lunch club, resilience, AI, and design formats
  • Securing the future: 20% employer contribution to company pension plan
  • Support in all situations: advice from pme Familienservice and the Mindance app
  • More than just vacation: 31 vacation days, including three joint “denkfrei days” (Christmas Eve, New Year's Eve, Carnival Monday)
  • Get started with support: Your personal denkmate will accompany you as you get started
  • Recommend us to others - Find Your Mate: Bring great people with you and we will thank you with a bonus
  • Discounts & goodies: Access to exclusive corporate benefits as well as free snacks, coffee, cool drinks, and fresh fruit


Ready to get started with us?

Then simply send us:

  • your resume
  • a short cover letter
  • your possible start date
  • and your salary expectations


How to get here

1. Application Receipt
We carefully review your documents and forward them to the relevant department.

2. Interviews
First interview: digitally via Microsoft Teams
Second interview: in person at one of our locations
Task? If so, we will let you know in good time

3. Individual Journey
If it makes sense to take a different approach, we will be happy to work with you to tailor the application process to your individual needs.

4. Feedback
We will get back to you as soon as possible. If you think it's taking too long, please feel free to contact us!


This is us, your contact persons

Janina Schulte-Kellinghaus & Marie Rybarczik, Talent Acquisition Team

Your Impact

  • Own and scale our Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts end-to-end — strategy, budget allocation, creative testing, and continuous optimization against CAC and pipeline targets.
  • Build and maintain landing pages and conversion tracking, so every euro of spend is measurable back to signed projects, not just clicks or impressions.
  • Live in the numbers: build your own reporting, connect marketing spend directly to sales revenue, and be ready to defend or change course based on what the data shows.
  • Bring a strong bias to action and a KPI-driven mindset — launch tests quickly, kill what doesn't work, double down on what does.
  • Get hands-on wherever the team needs it — organizing trade fairs and events, supporting PR outreach, running social media marketing, and producing sales materials for the field team.
  • Accept being measured the way we measure ourselves: on a blend of marketing performance and sales revenue outcomes, not marketing metrics in isolation.


✨ What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 3–5 years of hands-on performance marketing experience, with a strong focus on Google Ads and Meta Ads campaign management.
  • Very analytical and numbers-driven — comfortable building your own reporting and making budget calls from data, not gut feel.
  • Basic experience organizing events, setting up landing pages, and implementing conversion tracking.
  • Senior enough to own your channels end-to-end, but genuinely hands-on — open to supporting wherever needed, from fairs to PR to sales materials.
  • C2-level German and working English.
  • Based in Berlin.


☀️ Why You'll Love Working With Us:

  • Attractive VSOP package, market-rate compensation, and a performance-based bonus
  • Hybrid work setup (2 days/week in our Berlin office)
  • 30 vacation days and Deutschlandticket or Urban Sports Club membership
  • Real ownership from day one, flat hierarchies, and a steep learning curve

Bei uns gestaltest du die Zukunft! Swissbit ist der führende europäische Hersteller von Speicher- und Security-Lösungen für Industrie- und IoT-Anwendungen. Wir stärken die digitale und vernetzte Welt, indem wir Daten zuverlässig speichern und schützen. Für diese und viele weitere spannende Projekte suchen wir Kolleg:innen, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas bewegen wollen. Gemeinsam treiben wir die technologischen Innovationen von morgen voran – mit Leidenschaft, Mut und dem Anspruch, immer einen Schritt voraus zu sein. Deine Mission Als Production Test Engineer gestaltest Du die technische Performance unserer Produktionstestsysteme für Flash- und SmartCard-Speicherprodukte aktiv mit. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Testsysteme in der Serienproduktion stabil und leistungsfähig laufen. Dabei verbindest Du Dein Know-how in Hardware, Elektronik und systemnaher Software, um Fehler ganzheitlich zu analysieren und nachhaltige Lösungen umzusetzen. Bei neuen oder skalierenden Testlösungen arbeitest Du eng mit R&D zusammen und sorgst für eine robuste Überführung in die Serie. Spannende Aufgaben warten auf Dich Du betreust und optimierst unsere Produktionstestsysteme mit Schwerpunkt auf Testhardware, Elektronik und systemnaher Software. Du analysierst und behebst Störungen an Testsystemen und grenzt Produkt-, Prozess- und Systemursachen sicher voneinander ab. Du analysierst Testausfälle, Retest- und Yield-Themen, identifizierst technische Verlusttreiber und leitest nachhaltige Verbesserungsmaßnahmen ab. Du passt bestehende Testhardware, Elektronikbaugruppen, kleinere PCB-Designs und produktionsnahe Testsoftware an neue Anforderungen an. Du stellst die technische Performance bestehender Testsysteme über deren Lebenszyklus sicher und entwickelst diese bei veränderten Produktionsanforderungen gezielt weiter. Du begleitest die Überführung neu entwickelter oder skalierter Testlösungen von R&D in die Serienproduktion und stellst deren robuste Integration in den Serienbetrieb sicher. Du arbeitest eng mit R&D, Produktion, Quality, Maintenance und weiteren Schnittstellen zusammen und pflegst die technische Dokumentation. Dein Profil Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik, Technischen Informatik, Mechatronik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Du bringst gute Kenntnisse in Elektronik, elektronischer Messtechnik und Testsystemen mit. Du hast Erfahrung in der Fehlersuche und Analyse elektronischer Baugruppen, idealerweise im Produktions- oder Testumfeld. Du kennst Dich mit PCB-Design -Tools wie Eagle, Siemens Expedition oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen aus. Du verfügst über Programmierkenntnisse , idealerweise in C/C++ , sowie Grundkenntnisse in SQL . Du arbeitest analytisch, strukturiert und hands-on und kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch sowie gut auf Englisch. Was wir Dir bieten Sorgfältige Einarbeitung in ein motiviertes Team mit einem angenehmen Arbeitsklima & offener Kommunikationskultur Ideale fußläufige Anbindung über die BVG, S7 Raoul-Wallenberg-Str. Senior Frontend Engineer - React Researchgate Berlin Engineering Full-time 1 hour Engineering Full-time Berlin 1h ResearchGate is the professional network for scientists and researchers. From climate change and emerging diseases to food security and the responsible development of AI, the challenges facing our world are complex. Still, we’re optimistic about the power of millions of scientists working together to tackle them. We provide scientists with the help and support they need by connecting them to the world’s most active scientific community. We've built a platform that gives the world's scientists the tools and services they need to connect, collaborate, and advance their research. Over 25 million members from 193 countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research. Objective of the role We're looking for an enthusiastic frontend engineer with the skills and ability to turn great ideas into reality. You should have an in-depth understanding of current web technologies and front-end development, and be passionate about creating a great user experience. Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end. Join a team that encourages you to explore, learn, and go beyond, while seeing your work lead to actionable results. Put your creative problem-solving and development skills into action and make a positive impact on science and society. This is a full-time position based in Germany. The team You will be an integral part of the product team dedicated to enhancing ResearchGate's publisher-facing product. This role involves designing, constructing, and refining the platform to further our mission of facilitating global scientific connections and ensuring open access to research. At present, our team is working on making ResearchGate a great platform for publishers to connect with existing and future authors. Your immediate colleagues will consist of JavaScript and PHP engineers, an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, a UX Designer, and a UX Writer. Our team places great value on our collaborative and communicative work culture and we eagerly anticipate integrating a new Engineer into this environment. Responsibilites Create web interfaces using TypeScript and React for new products and features. Seamlessly integrate our front-end with our back-end world using GraphQL and PHP. Maintain and improve existing features and related infrastructure. Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver compelling publisher-facing products. Requirements 5+ years frontend web development experience in TypeScript (React), CSS Demonstrated ability to create code that is easily comprehensible, maintainable, and testable. Eagerness to acquire new skills, delve into different technologies and programming languages, and a willingness to acknowledge areas where expertise may be lacking. Approach problem-solving thoughtfully, embracing curiosity and maintaining an open-minded perspective. You are comfortable incorporating AI-assisted development tools into your daily workflow and exercise strong engineering judgment when evaluating and refining their output. Knowledge of GraphQL. It would be a plus if you already had knowledge of relational and document-based databases (we use MongoDB and Postgres). What we're looking for You take responsibility over your own solutions and continuously improve them. You engage in proactive and efficient communication within our distributed work environment. You focus on building a great product. You excel at designing and creating coherent, user-centric interfaces that display complex information. The interview process We start with a short call with HR or an Engineering Manager to align on the details of the job inquiry. There will be a longer discussion about your technical and professional experience and expectations with an Engineering Manager and another colleague. We’ll facilitate a technical interview with one or two engineers with some pair programming and technical discussion. You'll have a conversation with our VP of Product, Mark, and our VP of Engineering, Frank, to learn more about our product and engineering organization and discuss how your experience aligns with our goals. Last but not least, you will meet with our CEO, Ijad, and our VP of Finance & People team, Jess. source_record.description:
ResearchGate is the professional network for scientists and researchers. From climate change and emerging diseases to food security and the responsible development of AI, the challenges facing our world are complex. Still, we’re optimistic about the power of millions of scientists working together to tackle them. We provide scientists with the help and support they need by connecting them to the world’s most active scientific community.

We've built a platform that gives the world's scientists the tools and services they need to connect, collaborate, and advance their research. Over 25 million members from 193 countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research.


Objective of the role

We're looking for an enthusiastic frontend engineer with the skills and ability to turn great ideas into reality. You should have an in-depth understanding of current web technologies and front-end development, and be passionate about creating a great user experience. Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end.

Join a team that encourages you to explore, learn, and go beyond, while seeing your work lead to actionable results. Put your creative problem-solving and development skills into action and make a positive impact on science and society. This is a full-time position based in Germany.


The team

You will be an integral part of the product team dedicated to enhancing ResearchGate's publisher-facing product. This role involves designing, constructing, and refining the platform to further our mission of facilitating global scientific connections and ensuring open access to research. At present, our team is working on making ResearchGate a great platform for publishers to connect with existing and future authors.

Your immediate colleagues will consist of JavaScript and PHP engineers, an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, a UX Designer, and a UX Writer. Our team places great value on our collaborative and communicative work culture and we eagerly anticipate integrating a new Engineer into this environment.


Responsibilites

  • Create web interfaces using TypeScript and React for new products and features.

  • Seamlessly integrate our front-end with our back-end world using GraphQL and PHP.

  • Maintain and improve existing features and related infrastructure.

  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver compelling publisher-facing products.


    • Requirements

  • 5+ years frontend web development experience in TypeScript (React), CSS

  • Demonstrated ability to create code that is easily comprehensible, maintainable, and testable.

  • Eagerness to acquire new skills, delve into different technologies and programming languages, and a willingness to acknowledge areas where expertise may be lacking.

  • Approach problem-solving thoughtfully, embracing curiosity and maintaining an open-minded perspective.

  • You are comfortable incorporating AI-assisted development tools into your daily workflow and exercise strong engineering judgment when evaluating and refining their output.

  • Knowledge of GraphQL.

  • It would be a plus if you already had knowledge of relational and document-based databases (we use MongoDB and Postgres).


    • What we're looking for

  • You take responsibility over your own solutions and continuously improve them.

  • You engage in proactive and efficient communication within our distributed work environment.

  • You focus on building a great product.

  • You excel at designing and creating coherent, user-centric interfaces that display complex information.

    • The interview process

    • We start with a short call with HR or an Engineering Manager to align on the details of the job inquiry.

    • There will be a longer discussion about your technical and professional experience and expectations with an Engineering Manager and another colleague.

    • We’ll facilitate a technical interview with one or two engineers with some pair programming and technical discussion.

    • You'll have a conversation with our VP of Product, Mark, and our VP of Engineering, Frank, to learn more about our product and engineering organization and discuss how your experience aligns with our goals.

    • Last but not least, you will meet with our CEO, Ijad, and our VP of Finance & People team, Jess.

source_record.description:
At PPRO, we simplify access to local payments - providing a local payments platform that empowers giants like PayPal, Stripe, and Microsoft to connect with billions of consumers worldwide. We are on an ambitious, fast-paced mission to 3x our growth by 2028 - and we’re just getting started.

Our magic lies in our team of proud payments nerds. Spanning over 50 nationalities across 10+ global locations, our diverse cultures aren't a checklist; they are the competitive advantage driving our innovation. This is a people-first, high trust environment where you’ll have the autonomy to make a massive impact, own your work end-to-end, and grow through broad exposure, meaningful challenges, and continuous learning. We get things done, challenge respectfully, put the customer first, and recognise that our biggest successes are those we create as a team. If you’re ready to leave your footprint on global commerce, join us.
 
The Purpose:

At PPRO, Senior Software Engineers (m/w/x) make some of the most significant decisions for the company. Think of yourself as an important contributor to the success of your team, with a significant impact on the team’s product, but also on its culture and spirit. You will solve complex technical problems, participate in decisions on architecture and technical direction, support and mentor other engineers and work alongside them in the code.


What you'll do:

  • Own products and services end-to-end, from requirements till deployment in our production systems

  • Collaborate and grow in a dynamic and autonomous environment while working in small, agile teams

  • Be an integral part of a team, in addition to its culture and ways of working. Common practices include agile methodologies, pair and mob programming

  • Use the latest technologies to solve real problems for our customers at a massive scale

  • Be part of a team that will take full operational responsibility for the services that you own

  • Share your knowledge and build creative solutions while helping the team evolve best practices


What we look for in you:

  • Results-orientation, collaborative, pragmatic, and with a continuous improvement mindset

  • Multiple experiences working with one or more general-purpose programming languages including Java

  • Experience designing and building scalable products and services

  • Experience with the cloud (preferably AWS)

  • Great problem solving abilities

  • Working proficiency in English

  • Accounting/Fintech Domain: Experience with - or a strong interest in—the complexities of accounting systems or ledgers is a distinct advantage


Some of the technologies you’ll get to work with:

  • Java and Kotlin (latest versions)

  • Modern frameworks (Spring Boot, React)

  • Cloud-native systems (AWS, Kubernetes, Docker)

  • Event-driven architectures (SNS/SQS, Kinesis)

What's in it for you?
 
Hybrid working - We offer a hybrid structure with a 3 days / week on site expectation, so you can strike the balance between office and home working. In addition to our 30-day holiday allowance, we also provide a work from abroad policy, enabling employees to work remotely for up to another 30 days per year.
 
Learning and Development - We offer a €1,000 annual budget to support your professional growth—because investing in your development benefits us all. In addition, we provide leadership cafés, on-the-job training, and other opportunities to help you grow your skills and thrive in your role.
 
Insurance - Because better safe than sorry - we want our employees to benefit from various insurances including accident insurance, disability insurance, direct insurance (bAV) and travel insurance. 
 
Gym membership - PPRO helps contribute towards the costs of your gym membership, supporting your physical fitness journey while easing the burden on your wallet
 
Enhance Family Leave - We understand the importance of family - that's why we offer enhanced family leave to support you during key life moments.
 
 
Mental Health Platform - We’ve teamed up with a top well-being platform to provide one-on-one therapy, chat therapy, therapist-led courses, guided meditations, and more.
 
Pet-friendly office - Because work is better with your paw-tners by your side
 
 
Our Principles: 
 
We get things done: We are courageous; we take ownership, make decisions and get things done.
 
We act with trust and integrity: We listen first and challenge respectfully. We seek out and leverage diverse perspectives. We welcome and offer honest and open feedback, always assuming positive intent
 
We put the customer first: We are laser focused on delivering outstanding outcomes for our customers. We put the customer at the heart of what we do.
 
We make things better: We boldly explore  new ideas and have an unwavering commitment to continuous improvement.
 
We work as a team: We collaborate closely and value team success over individual achievement.

Reporting to the Sales Director Data Centres you will play a key role in driving new business growth across the Enterprise market. You will do this by partnering, 'selling with' with the sales teams of our DC customers to develop connectivity solutions for their DC tenants. Working in an experienced team, you will have the opportunity to develop and close large-scale European network opportunities (100G/400G) with Enterprise organisations that require high-performance connectivity across multiple locations. While you will also support the development of a small number of existing accounts, the primary focus of this role is building pipeline, acquiring new logos and expanding euNetworks’ presence within the Enterprise sector. You will have the support of our Sales Engineering team, with multiple engineers and additional account support available. You will also work closely with our Network Development, Digital Enablement and Product teams to shape solutions that meet customer needs and drive successful outcomes. What will you be doing? Identify, target and win new Enterprise customers, building a strong pipeline of opportunities across the Europe. Develop and execute new business sales strategies to expand euNetworks’ presence in the Enterprise market. Build relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders within prospective customer organisations. Drive opportunities from initial engagement through contract signature, meeting or exceeding sales and revenue targets. Maintain a strong understanding of the Enterprise connectivity market, identifying trends, potential customers and new opportunities. Network at industry events, customer meetings and campaigns to generate leads and strengthen euNetworks’ market presence. Work closely with Sales Engineering and Product teams to develop technically and commercially viable solutions for customers. Collaborate with commercial and finance teams to develop strong business cases and proposals. Support the development and growth of selected existing accounts, identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling. Effectively manage sales activity and pipeline through Salesforce.com, ensuring accurate reporting and data integrity What do we want from you? Significant sales experience within Telecoms, Connectivity, Infrastructure or Technology markets Strong new business development experience, with a proven ability to generate pipeline and win new customers A track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets Experience selling connectivity, network infrastructure or data centre solutions to Enterprise customers An entrepreneurial mindset, with the drive to identify opportunities and develop new relationships Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills Experience managing complex sales cycles and multiple stakeholders Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail A self-starter who is comfortable prospecting and building opportunities from scratch Good understanding of the European Telecoms and Enterprise connectivity market If this position is of interest but you don’t think you meet all of the criteria listed, please consider applying still. euNetworks looks to recruit people with the right attitude, potential and ambition and for the right candidate, we will provide further training and support to enable you to develop in the role. Employees have access to a comprehensive wellbeing programme that promotes mental health and also recognises the importance of work-life balance through initiatives such as a dedicated birthday day off and “give back” days to support volunteering activities. euNetworks’ bonus scheme is linked to both individual contribution and overall company performance with opportunity to overachieve in both areas. In addition, euNetworks operates a flexible hybrid working policy, enabling employees to balance in-office collaboration with remote work, fostering productivity, autonomy and a positive employee experience. We work as a team promoting a culture of collaboration, trust and respect where every individual is heard. We strive to make the hiring process equitable and accessible for all. Providing candidates with the opportunity to be their true selves and explore how you might thrive at euNetworks. We are a recognised Disability Confident employer and will make provisions where possible to support you through the interview process, if you require any reasonable accommodation through the selection process, please let your Talent Partner know. What do we do? euNetworks is a pan-European provider of bandwidth infrastructure services and a vital enabler of Cloud and AI adoption. We’re the leading connectivity partner for data centre companies and their customers in Europe, directly connecting over 600 data centres today. We own and operate 18 metropolitan city networks connected with a high capacity intercity backbone covering 53 cities in 17 countries. A leading provider of cloud connectivity, we directly connect to all major cloud platforms. Mildenhall Data Science 25 minutes Data Science Mildenhall 25m Clarity Innovations is a trusted national security partner, dedicated to safeguarding our nation’s interests and delivering innovative solutions that empower the Intelligence Community (IC) and Department of Defense (DoD) to transform data into actionable intelligence, ensuring mission success in an evolving world. Our mission-first software and data engineering platform modernizes data operations, utilizing advanced workflows, CI/CD, and secure DevSecOps practices. We focus on challenges in Information Warfare, Cyber Operations, Operational Security, and Data Structuring, enabling end-to-end solutions that drive operational impact. We are committed to delivering cutting-edge tools and capabilities that address the most complex national security challenges, empowering our partners to stay ahead of emerging threats and ensuring the success of their critical missions. At Clarity, we are people-focused and set on being a destination employer for top talent, offering an environment where innovation thrives, careers grow, and individuals are valued. Join us as we continue to lead innovation and tackle the most pressing challenges in national security. Role This role is for a Data Scientist on a close-knit team supporting Air Force Special Operations Command (AFSOC) at RAF Mildenhall, UK. This team is at the center of helping the command empower and leverage its data for more effective analysis and decision making. As a subject matter expert, the Data Scientist will leverage their experience to gather and derive insights from complex data, assist the command with development initiatives, and facilitate digital transformation efforts. The work done in this role has a direct impact on mission readiness as the team's efforts go toward making a more resilient and data-driven organization. Responsibilities A Data Scientist will have skills sets of both data analysts and data engineers. Data scientists are responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining a data pipeline. In addition, data scientists shall interpret and analyze complex sets of data, as well as plan, execute, and manage ML projects with cloud-native platforms and advanced ML solutions. They understand some of the most challenging processes, technologies, and can leverage a vast array of methodologies in the field, such as data mining, natural language programming, and machine learning. Data scientists must have a combination of skills that includes programming, mathematical modeling, statistics, and domain knowledge. They must combine an advanced math and statistics background with programming, domain knowledge, and communication skills to analyze data, create applied mathematical models, and present results in a form useful to the organization. Perform statistical modeling and create data visualizations using products like Tableau, Microsoft Power BI and R Shiny. • Research, design, and implement algorithms to solve complex problems. Program using R, Python (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas) or similar analytical languages. • Perform data engineering, data processing and modeling techniques using cloud-based data management, data science, and ML platforms such as Databricks, IBM Cloud Pak, Cloudera, and Snowflake. • Communicate complex concepts and hypothesis to a non-technical audience through digital storytelling. About AirOps

AirOps is the full-service platform for brand growth in the age of AI search. As consumers shift from traditional search engines to platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, the entire ruleset of growth is being rewritten. Buyers now rely on agents to discover, recommend, and purchase products and services for them. If your brand isn't part of the answer, you aren't in the running.

Our platform offers everything a brand needs to get found, recommended, and earn trust. We work with category leaders, including teams at Ramp, Chime, Airbnb, ServiceNow, and Rippling, to drive visibility and accelerate growth from AI search.

Backed by Greylock, Unusual Ventures, Wing VC, and Founder Collective, we're headquartered in San Francisco, New York, and Montevideo.

About the Role:

AirOps is opening its first dedicated EMEA sales development role at a moment when AI-driven content discovery is reshaping how European brands compete. You will own the full outbound motion across EMEA, prospecting into marketing and growth teams in the UK, DACH, Nordics, Benelux, France, Southern Europe, and beyond. This is not a UK-only seat.

You will build pipeline across multiple markets, navigating different buying cultures and business contexts every day. You'll work cross-functionally with Sales and GTM Engineering to turn intent signals into qualified discovery calls that map prospect pain to our AI capabilities. Based hybrid out of our central London office, you are the first face of AirOps for EMEA buyers. The role reports into our Sales leadership and carries a direct line to how quickly we scale internationally. If you want a front-row seat to building a region from scratch, this is it.

 

What you'll own:

  • Build the Engine: As one of the founding EMEA SDRs, you'll develop and execute creative outreach strategies that don't just hit targets, they crush them. You'll be the one finding the "needles in the haystack" and turning them into qualified pipeline.

  • Be an AI Matchmaker: Conduct discovery calls that act as deep-dive consultations. Your goal is to map prospect pain points to our AI capabilities, not just read a script.

  • Own the First Impression: You are the first face of AirOps. You’ll build authentic, high-trust relationships with key decision-makers before they even realize they need a better workflow.

  • Pass the Torch: Work in lockstep with our Account Executives to ensure that every handoff is seamless, qualified, and set up for a closed-won win.

  • The "Data Artist": Keep our CRM (our "Source of Truth") clean, organized, and actionable. We value data-driven iteration—if an email template isn't working, iterate, A/B test, and optimize until it does.

  • Startup Speed: In a high-growth environment, agility is your superpower. Whether you're troubleshooting a new outreach tool or jumping on a last-minute demo, you thrive on the "all-hands-on-deck" pace.

 

What you'll bring:

  • The "Hungry" Factor: 0-1 years of B2B SaaS sales experience. If you’ve got the grit, we’ll provide the roadmap. Bonus points if you’ve spent time in the marketing or growth-tech trenches.

  • Outreach Ninja: Whether it's a cold call, a hyper-personalized email, or a strategic LinkedIn connection, you know how to cut through the noise without sounding like a bot.

  • High EQ & Active Listening: You know that discovery is 80% listening and 20% speaking. You have the empathy to understand a prospect's frustrations and the communication skills to offer the solution.

  • Bias for Action: You are just as comfortable running solo on a new project as you are jumping into a team brainstorming session. You own your outcomes.

  • A Track Record of "Done": Whether it’s a side project, a degree, or a previous job, you have a history of starting things and actually finishing them.

  • The Vibe-Coder Mindset: We build with AI, and we want you to understand it. Experience coding, scripting, or playing around with "vibe-coding" platforms (Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, etc.) is a massive plus. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you've ideally gone beyond simply using LLMs as research and content-generation tools.

  • Nice to have: Fluent in a European language beyond English. German, French, Spanish, Dutch, or a Nordic language would open doors across key EMEA markets.

Compensation Band: £65-80K OTE [60/40]

Every campaign you launch will be tied to a business problem our customers are actively trying to solve, and to the pipeline and bookings that follow.

The role blends ambitious strategic thinking with confident hands-on delivery. You will work shoulder to shoulder with partners, regional sales leaders and the wider marketing organisation to extend Sitecore's reach through and with our ecosystem, and you will see the impact of your work in the pipeline, in partner momentum, and in the customers we win together. You will take on a broad and genuinely influential remit across EMEA, Asia Pacific and our international reseller network:

What You Will Do:

  • Align partner marketing to the FY27 buying motions: Translate Sitecore's buying motions into partner-ready campaigns, narratives and assets, ensuring every parent campaign is correctly aligned and consistently tracked

  • Build joint plans with EMEA and APAC implementation partners: Develop and manage ambitious quarterly marketing plans with our systems integrators and implementation partners, using multi-channel tactics—webinars, events, digital campaigns, executive roundtables—to create demand and pipeline in-region

  • Support our growing international reseller business: Design scalable, repeatable marketing programmes and campaign-in-a-box toolkits that equip resellers across international markets to generate and progress demand independently, with the messaging, enablement and support they need to succeed

  • Drive pipeline and revenue through the channel: Align every partner programme to regional sales objectives, generating new-customer leads, accelerating pipeline and contributing directly to bookings targets for Sitecore's core and new offers

  • Develop and champion partner relationships: Build trusted, energising relationships with key partners and reseller leaders. Work closely with partner account managers to spot joint opportunities, shape go-to-market programmes and keep partners engaged, informed and invested

  • Coordinate across regions and functions: Partner with Field Marketing, Corporate Marketing, Product Marketing, Campaigns and Sales across EMEA and Asia Pacific to adapt global content for partner use, respecting local market nuance while keeping messaging consistent and on-brand

  • Measure, learn and report: Track programme performance against clear KPIs, analyse results across campaigns, regions and channels to determine ROI and best practice, and share regular, insight-rich reporting with internal stakeholders and partners alike

  • Manage budget and Marketing Development Funds: Own the partner marketing budget, including MDF and co-op funds, allocating investment to the partners, markets and motions with the greatest potential for return

What You Need to Succeed:

  • A minimum of 5 years of B2B marketing experience, including direct experience with partner or channel marketing programmes in the technology or software industry

  • Experience marketing across multiple international markets—EMEA and/or Asia Pacific especially—with genuine sensitivity to cultural and market differences

  • Confidence building campaigns around solution and outcome-led themes rather than product features

  • Demand generation and account-based marketing (ABM) skills

  • An analytical and data-driven mindset

  • Marketing technology proficiency: familiarity with modern marketing tools and platforms is required, including CRM software such as Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, web analytics tools, content management systems, and business intelligence dashboards

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the credibility to influence senior partner and internal stakeholders

  • Strategic and creative thinking, paired with the drive to deliver hands-on

Additional Skills That Could Set You Apart

  • Experience working with global or regional DXP systems integrators and implementation partners

  • Experience building reseller or distributor marketing programmes at scale

  • Familiarity with Sitecore or other martech and digital experience products

  • Understanding of AI-led marketing use cases, including AI search visibility and digital asset management

Equal Opportunities at Sitecore

Sitecore is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity without unlawful regard to race, colour, ancestry, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status or any other local legally protected characteristic.

Introduction to Role & Team

Badoo is one of the world's largest dating apps, connecting millions of people across the globe. It's a mature, much-loved product with enormous reach, and we're in the middle of an ambitious chapter: modernising the experience, sharpening how we help members find real connections, and building a healthier, more sustainable business.

As a Senior Product Designer on Badoo, you'll help shape that next chapter. You'll take end-to-end ownership of meaningful surfaces - onboarding, people discovery, chatting,, and the monetisation experiences that sit alongside them - designing for a global, diverse, and value-conscious membership. This is high-craft product design under real-world constraints: a lean, fast-moving team, an experiment-led culture, and a design foundation we're actively rebuilding.

You'll be a key voice at the intersection of product, engineering, research, and data - balancing sharp product thinking and strong craft with commercial pragmatism and a deep respect for the people who use Badoo. If you're energised by scale, comfortable making trade-offs explicit, and want your work to move both member and business outcomes, this is a rare canvas to work on.

What You’ll Do

  • Own end-to-end design for multiple Badoo surfaces leading the work from discovery and problem framing through interaction design, visual polish, and delivery.

  • Design experiences that balance member value with commercial impact: paywalls, consumables and subscription flows that feel fair and clear. Monetisation is central to Badoo's roadmap, and great design is what makes it work for members and the business.

  • Work in an experiment-led way. Most meaningful changes ship as A/B tests with clear hypotheses and guardrails, so you'll design for iteration and learning, not just a single polished hand-off, and stay close to the results.

  • Help modernise Badoo's design foundations. Our design system is a work in progress; you'll contribute patterns and components that raise consistency and quality across a large, mature product.

  • Collaborate closely with PMs, UXR, data science, and engineers to frame problems, validate hypotheses, synthesise insights, and evolve designs based on evidence, accepting that data is sometimes imperfect and that judgment matters.

  • Ship pragmatically within a lean team. Prioritise for member and business outcomes over perfection, make trade-offs explicit, and know when to push for the ideal experience and when to ship a well-reasoned version.

  • Design for a global, inclusive audience - a diverse international membership across many markets, languages, and devices - and for platform and compliance requirements as they evolve.

  • Apply AI-powered tools and methods to accelerate exploration, improve accessibility, and personalise experiences responsibly.

  • Give and receive design critique with precision and care while elevating the work around you and modelling a culture of high craft standards.

  • Model Bumble’s core competencies: collaborate with purpose, take ownership, adapt with agility, and deliver from insight to impact.

  • Embody our values of Courage, Respect, and Joy in how you work and the experiences you create.

About You

  • You’re an experienced end-to-end product designer with a track record of delivering thoughtful, high-quality mobile experiences from ambiguity to release.

  • You have a strong product mind: you frame problems before jumping to solutions, connect design decisions to user and business outcomes, and think in systems as much as screens.

  • You're commercially fluent and comfortable designing monetisation experiences that feel fair, and are a well-crafted part of the product rather than a bolt-on.

  • You thrive with constraints. You're pragmatic about scope, comfortable in a lean and fast-moving team, and energised by working on a mature product that needs modernising.

  • You're at home in an experiment-driven environment: designing for A/B tests, iterating on results, and reasoning under uncertainty in a two-sided marketplace where impact is hard to predict.

  • Your visual and interaction design craft is strong, your work is polished, considered, and reflects a deep understanding of what makes digital experiences feel right.

  • You bring real intentionality to your process: from how you frame a problem to how you design a transition, your work shows rigour, purpose, and care.

  • You balance user empathy with commercial pragmatism and know when to push for the ideal experience and when to ship a well-reasoned version.

  • You’re fluent in Figma and modern prototyping tools and you use them to think as well as to communicate.

  • You’re grounded in inclusive design principles and accessibility standards, and you bring a global mindset to your work.

  • You’re curious about AI’s role in product experiences and you apply these tools with ethical care and creative intention.

  • You take full ownership of your work: you drive things to a conclusion, communicate proactively, and build trust with partners across disciplines.

  • Typically requires 5-8 years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.

 

✨ Kind, curious, and low-ego designers thrive at Bumble Inc. If you’re excited to shape how people around the world form relationships and find belonging, we’d love to hear from you.

Benefits & Perks

  • Annual personal learning & development budget

  • Private Medical Insurance (PMI)

  • Private Dental Insurance

  • Babylon Health app

  • Mental health support

  • Enhanced parental leave, including a highly competitive maternity package

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Subsidised gym membership

  • ‘Double matched’ pension contributions up to 6%

  • Premium App Access

About Us

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes.

We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us.
